title: VP, Head of Product - Advertising
jd_excerpt:
Our mission on the Advertising Product & Technology team is to build a next generation advertising platform that aligns with our unique value proposition for audio and video. We work to scale the user experience for hundreds of millions of fans and hundreds of thousands of advertisers. This scale brings unique challenges as well as tremendous opportunities for our artists and creators.


Spotify has the opportunity to build one of the world's most distinctive advertising businesses at the intersection of audio, video, display, and creator culture, powered by deep audience insights and a global platform reaching hundreds of millions of people.
We're looking for a VP, Head of Product, Advertising to help define what advertising on Spotify becomes. Building on the transformation of our advertising platform, you'll shape the next generation of advertising products and experiences, how brands connect with audiences, and unlock new opportunities for growth. You'll balance strengthening and scaling our core platform with creating entirely new products, capabilities, and business opportunities that differentiate Spotify in the market.
Reporting directly to the SVP of Advertising, you'll be a member of the global Advertising leadership team within a business with end-to-end P&L accountability. You'll set the strategic direction for our advertising product portfolio, lead a global Product and Design organization, and partner closely with Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Business Development, and Partnerships to translate Spotify's unique position in content, culture, and technology into compelling advertiser experiences and sustainable business growth.

What You'll Do
Create new advertising experiences and monetization opportunities. Develop new ad formats, business models, and revenue streams that leverage Spotify’s global audience, first-party insights, creator ecosystem, and position across music, podcasts, and video. Harness AI — including generative AI, conversational buying, and personalization — to reimagine how brands connect with audiences and to unlock growth across new advertiser verticals. Make disciplined investment decisions across competitive necessities and differentiated capabilities.
 Champion the customer and represent our vision. Ground the product organization in advertiser and agency needs, market dynamics, and customer insights. Communicate a compelling strategy to senior leadership, advertisers, agencies, and partners.
 Connect product to business outcomes. Partner with Engineering, Commercial, and Business Development leadership to improve advertiser adoption, campaign performance, monetization, and long-term growth — evaluating build-versus-partner opportunities and translating strategic relationships into scalable capabilities.
 Build an exceptional organization. Attract, develop, and lead a high-performing global Product and Design team, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and strong execution.
Who You Are
You are an accomplished product executive with 15+ years of experience defining and scaling sophisticated technology products, including 5+ years leading large, multilayered Product organizations.
 You bring deep advertising technology expertise, ideally spanning programmatic advertising, auctions, self-service, targeting, optimization, measurement, and monetization.
 You have personally led meaningful product or business transformations — not simply extending an existing roadmap, but fundamentally reshaping product strategy, go-to-market approach, or business model to drive step-change growth and competitive differentiation.
 You have a demonstrated track record of building products that drive meaningful customer adoption, business growth, and competitive differentiation.
 You combine strategic imagination with exceptional product judgment and the ability to make difficult investment tradeoffs.
 You are forward-thinking about AI and emerging technologies and can translate technological change into compelling customer experiences and new business opportunities.
 You understand how advertisers and agencies make investment decisions and can connect customer needs with product strategy and commercial outcomes.
 You have successfully built, scaled, and transformed large, multidisciplinary Product and Design organizations, attracting exceptional talent and developing strong senior leaders.
 You are an influential, collaborative executive who partners effectively across Engineering, Commercial, Data, and Business Development.
 You balance long-term vision with operational discipline, moving quickly, simplifying complexity, and delivering measurable results.
Where You'll Be
New York is the preferred location for this role.
 We are open to considering exceptional candidates based elsewhere, with the expectation of 30% travel to support leadership collaboration, customer engagement, and business priorities.
The United States base range for this position is $373,310 to $533,300 plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays, paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.


Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview
